# Sri Lanka for Indians

> Independent guide and introduction service helping Indians plan destination weddings, buy property, set up businesses (including in Port City Colombo) and travel in Sri Lanka. WhatsApp +94 71 614 7945.

Key facts (verified October 2026):
- Indian passport holders get a free 30 day double entry tourist ETA for Sri Lanka since 25 May 2026; apply at eta.gov.lk.
- India was Sri Lanka's largest tourist source market: 431,162 Indian arrivals January to September 2026 (SLTDA).
- Port City Colombo (Regulation 01 of 2025; Amendment Act No. 1 of 2026): corporate income tax holidays of 8 to 15 years for primary Businesses of Strategic Importance depending on investment size, 7.5% for 4 years for secondary businesses, subject to approval. Since 20 January 2026 employment income of staff at newly approved companies is taxable; companies approved earlier keep a staff exemption until 31 January 2029.
- Foreigners can buy condominium units above ground floor outright when paid via inward foreign remittance; USD 100,000 property investment supports a renewable 5 year residence visa.
- Sri Lanka 2025 exports: total USD 17.25B; apparel and textiles USD 4.91B; ICT/BPM USD 1.64B; tea USD 1.51B; spices and essential oils USD 450M (EDB).
- UPI works in Sri Lanka at LankaQR merchants (launched February 2024). Sri Lanka runs on IST (UTC+5:30).
- Indians can buy condominium units in Sri Lanka outright on any floor (floor limit removed 2018), paid in full from abroad through an Inward Investment Account. Freehold land is barred for foreigners (Act No. 38 of 2014); land can be leased for up to 99 years.
- Investor visa: USD 100,000 for 5 years, USD 200,000 for 10 years; a condo purchase qualifies. Digital nomad visa launched February 2026 (1 year, USD 2,000 monthly income, USD 500 fee).
- Tourist visa extensions run up to 270 days in total. Business ETA for SAARC nationals: USD 30, multiple entry, 30 days.
- 531,511 Indians visited Sri Lanka in 2025, its largest market. The Nanu Oya to Ella train reopened June 2026; Kandy sections are under repair until about end 2026.
- City of Dreams Sri Lanka (John Keells and Melco), South Asia's first integrated resort, opened August 2025: Cinnamon Life (687 rooms) and Nüwa (113 rooms), casino, mall, 17 restaurants and bars. Legal drinking age in Sri Lanka is 21; bars close on Poya days.
- India Sri Lanka FTA in force since 1 March 2000; about 81% of tariff lines duty free; rules of origin 35% value addition.
- India and Sri Lanka trade can be invoiced, paid and settled in Indian rupees through Special Rupee Vostro Accounts (RBI framework, July 2022). The rupee is on Sri Lanka's list of designated foreign currencies. Since October 2025 Indian banks can lend INR to Sri Lankan businesses and banks for cross border trade; since July 2026 Indian banks open vostro accounts without a separate RBI approval.
